sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy immigration page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and includes Brunei, separately from conditional third-country visa or residence routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Brunei

policies.title: Bruneian ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy immigration guidance names Brunei in its no-visa visitor-country list for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Bruneian passport holder, visitor stay of up to three months; carry the stated passport validity, return/onward travel and funds where requested.
Employment, residence, transit, conditional third-country visa or residence routes, special passports and final admission remain separate.
